sources.entry: Andi - Andi is a generative AI-powered search engine #free

summary.name: Andi
summary.one_liner: Andi is an AI-powered search engine that gives direct answers with sources instead of just a list of links, with no ads or tracking.
use_cases: exploring web content with visual results
summary.what_it_does: Andi is presented as an AI search agent that answers questions and finds web content. It aims to give concise answers rather than only links. The page says it is private and anonymous, with no ads, spam or tracking. It offers AI-assisted research and writing that is meant to produce factual content with sources. It also shows visual search results and smart summary cards. The page itself does not describe the underlying models or how sources are chosen in detail.
notable: Direct AI answers instead of only links
Private and anonymous, no ads or tracking
Visual search results and smart summary cards
caveats: The page shows an apology for search errors during recent upgrades
The 87% accuracy claim and comparisons to Google, ChatGPT and Perplexity come from the meta description and are not verified on the page
